title: LocalMark synthetic capability search regression benchmark
scope: Manually authored synthetic cards and relevance judgments. No live endpoints, task execution, competitor comparison, or independent quality rating.

metrics.precision_at_5: Relevant retrieved in the first five divided by 5, even if fewer results were returned.
metrics.precision_retrieved_at_5: Relevant retrieved divided by the number actually returned up to five; zero for an empty positive query.
metrics.recall_at_5: Relevant retrieved in the first five divided by all manually judged relevant fixture agents.
metrics.reciprocal_rank_at_5: 1 / first relevant result position within five, or zero if none.
metrics.no_match_accuracy: Fraction of designated no-match queries returning no candidates; excluded from relevance averages.
metrics.constraint_violations: Count of returned top-five IDs manually annotated as failing a required evidence/authentication/transport constraint.
metrics.caveat: A small maintainer-authored fixture regression exercise; results do not establish live task quality, independent assessment, or superiority to other directories.
